recent_excerpts: CVE-2025-39964, a race condition in the Linux kernel's AF_ALG socket code, is now in CISA's KEV catalog. Federal agencies must remediate by September 21, 2026.
CVE-2026-60004, a 9.8-CVSS Gitea RCE, is under active attack per CISA. Attackers with repo write access can run shell commands. Patch now.
CISA added CVE-2026-9082 (CVSS 6.5) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after evidence of active exploitation against all supported Drupal Core versions.
